Vista Social vs VEXI: Social Media Suite and AI Content Studio
Vista Social and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Vista Social is a social media management platform for teams and agencies [1][2]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on publishing, and in many ways they fit together.

Vista Social is a social media management platform for teams and agencies [1][2]. Its plans include publishing and scheduling, one inbox for messages, comments and reviews, reports, and Ask Vista, an AI assistant you can ask to plan, publish, report and reply [2]. On June 1, 2026 it added AI image generation and AI video generation (text to video, image to video and library to video) in its Composer and in Ask Vista [3]. Its Professional plan covers 15 social profiles, Advanced 30, Scale 70, and Enterprise is unlimited [2].

VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Vista Social is built to plan, publish, answer and report across many profiles, and its AI makes images and short videos for your posts [2][3]. VEXI makes the content: your own clips edited with B-roll, music and captions, posts designed in your brand, and Autopilot runs your week ahead. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.

In Vista Social you draft a post in the Composer or ask Ask Vista; its AI writes captions and generates images and short videos from a prompt, a photo or a library asset, then sends them to a scheduled post [2][3].
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Ask Vista is its AI command center: you ask it to plan, publish, report and reply across your profiles [2].
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.

How much does Vista Social cost?

Vista Social’s pricing page lists Professional (15 social profiles, 2 users), Advanced (30 and 3), Scale (70 and 4) and Enterprise (unlimited profiles), with a free trial and 20% off for yearly billing [2]. Check that page for the current price of each plan [2].
